To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
(1) The intelligent spiders developed in this research can be used as intelligent agents for Internet searching.

(1) a personal intelligent spider can be built by using the genetic algorithm and best first search to dynamically analyze the contents of users' selected home pages as the starting point for searching the most relevant home pages based on the links; (2) the spider can adjust control parameters based on the users' preferences, and (3) the genetic algorithm is better than the best first search in the searching efficiency.

a new approach to build intelligent spider based on genetic algorithm has been proposed, and the performance of the genetic algorithm is better than the best first search based spider.
